_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Hillerød (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 2 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from DSB's or Banedanmark's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Street/platform level: S-tog perron 1 (tracks 1/11) and perron 2 (tracks 3/4), 92 cm; Lokaltog tracks 11 and 12 (new platforms being built)
levels.name_source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027 Bilag 3.6 + Banedanmark Open Data (platform register dk_register), read 2026-10-30; Banedanmark/Niras screening application "NFSP0576/NA 0074 Hillerød Station - opgradering og fornyelse", https://www.trafikstyrelsen.dk/Media/638930050665056206/Ans%c3%b8gning.PDF, read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Danmarks Højdemodel, © Klimadatastyrelsen, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/860000683).
Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 9 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000683).

platform_refs_source.r15763360: Banedanmark Open Data (CC BY 4.0) platform objects perron 1 / track 1, perron 1 / track 11, perron 2 / track 4 run alongside osm:way/r15763360; tracks 1, 3, 4, 11 from the register (banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv) run alongside osm:way/r15763360, read 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/860000683); BanInfo's track numbers were being re-issued then: check on site

1, 3, 4, 11._source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts), Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30; TIB 82: tracks 3,4, class 92 cm = 0.92 m above rail, 218 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
